label: Bible Study
prompt: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man _____, let him come unto me, and drink.
verse: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
note: Shouted on the last great day of the feast — an open invitation to come and drink.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not _____, but speak, and hold not thy peace:
verse: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:
note: In Corinth the Lord came to Paul by night: be not afraid, keep speaking — I am with thee.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's _____?
verse: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?
note: After a three-day search, Jesus' first recorded words: he had to be about his Father's business.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be _____ to me a sinner.
verse: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
note: The tax collector's seven-word prayer went home justified; the Pharisee's speech about himself didn't.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my _____, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
verse: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
note: David stacks up names for God in one breath — rock, fortress, deliverer, high tower — and 'buckler,' a small round shield.
